usedFor: ButterCMS holds pages and posts, Dropbox receives files, and “Page Published” can start “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “Page Published” in ButterCMS, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: It saves a file from a public web link into a chosen folder, with replace or update options.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” needs a public web link, so a trigger like “Page Draft Saved” must supply one.
